m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Why hello there, Wizard. I'm so glad you decided to pay me a visit. I often use you as an example to inspire my younger students.
You're looking for the Eye of History? Oh. I had hoped we finally put Malistaire to rest, but his story always seems to come back up again.
No clues here at the school, but you might try Malistaire's house in Dark Cave. I don't think anyone's been in there since... well, a long time.
One thing to know - after Sylvia's death, I think he did some remodeling, so who knows what you might find in there, but yeah... good luck!
<ITALICS>Memories of tragedy and triumph wash over you as you enter the home of your former nemesis. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>Portraits and keepsakes remind you that this was not just Malistaire's house, but Sylvia Drake's as well.  </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>You feel an eerie sense of foreboding when you look at the door at the back of the hall. It's probably worth investigating. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>The back halls of the home have been transformed into a sanctum of undeath. They now smell of corpse candles and a deep, frustrated emptiness. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>It was into these chambers that Malistaire came after Sylvia's death, first in mourning... and later in madness. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>A dark spirit, appointed by the Master Necromancer to protect his work, still maintains its vigil. You must defeat it to proceed. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>With the Spectral Guardian defeated, you can now explore deeper into Malistaire's Sanctum. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>Across the room, you see Malistaire's desk. Here he sat, feverishly searching old tomes for a way to bring Sylvia back. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>On the desk, open to the page where Malistaire left it, lies what appears to be a Journal. You should read it for clues. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>As you begin reading the Journal, you can almost hear Malistaire's voice. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>My efforts to resurrect Sylvia have met no success, but I've heard of a mysterious group of Scholars called the Cabal. They may know a way. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>This Cabal lives up to its reputation. They communicate through a masked agent who goes only by the initials G and D. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>Nervous as it makes me to deal with this Cabal, they claim to have the answers I seek. What choice do I have? I meet them tonight. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>In exchange for information, the Cabal demands I give them the Eye of History. They plan to take it to the world of Mirage. I know not why. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>I am conflicted. I fear what the Cabal's intentions in Mirage may be, but I've come too far to turn back now... </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>I made the exchange. The secret to resurrecting Sylvia lies within an ancient tome known as the Krokonomicon. To Krokotopia, I go. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>You close the Journal, and place it in your backpack. Headmaster Ambrose needs to see this. </ITALICS>
So it's you - the Headmaster's little pet. Been a long time, but I always knew we'd cross paths again. You've grown in power... I have too.
My associates now make Ambrose look like a hedge wizard. Perhaps you've heard of... the Cabal? They have agents everywhere - even Wizard City.
After this, I'll be a full-fledged member. See, they detected an intruder here and sent me. That journal's not going anywhere... neither are you!
Oh, now you've really done it. You think you won here? You have no idea. You crossed the Cabal! Oh yeah. You'll hear from us again!
Ooh. Malistaire's Journal. I shudder to think what insanity is expressed within these pages. Hmm. Nonetheless, I will have to read it.
But you're here about Bartleby, aren't you? Yes. His condition has grown worse, hasn't it? I just can't fathom why this is happening.
Oh? He mentioned the Eye of History? Yes, he has been rather nostalgic lately, but perhaps the Eye could help restore his health too.
Of course, we both know that it was Malistaire who stole Bartleby's Eye. But we never learned what he did with it, did we?
An oversight, to be sure. I suggest you go to the Death School and see Dworgyn. Ask if he has any idea where Malistaire would've hidden it.
If you learn anything about the Eye of History, let me know. I only hope Malistaire didn't destroy it.
